subject: Observed inability to follow symlinks for featureCounts

messages.author: 0f80b15a80cf9c6f
messages.subject: Observed inability to follow symlinks for featureCounts
parts:
Hi,

I have observed that featureCounts has problems following symlinks :-( I have a few hundred pairs of BAM/BAI files, classified according to source and tissue type and to simplify my analysis pipeline, I created symlinks to the originals in a single folder, with recoded names for reading.  When I try featureCounts with the original file, it runs a-ok, telling me that it detected a BAM file; however if I try using the symlink, it fails by telling me that it failed to open the file and labelling it an unknown file. However, if I try both paths with samtools flagstat, no problems are observed: both provides the expected results. This tells me that featureCounts does not resolve symlinks. Is that the case? If it is, is there a flag to add to tell it to do so?

Thanks in advance

S. Foisy
Project Manager
Bioinformatics
Montreal Heart Institute
Montreal, Qc
